name: Shirosaki Homura
source:
Kurumi’s underclassman. Being unusually observant of her daily schedule, he comes to realize her lack of companionship, and tries his best to keep her company whenever she needs it. He confesses his love to her, but admits that he doesn’t need an answer right away.

(Taken from eroderekko)
